title: Minimum policy concepts

statement.en: Usage conditions shall travel with the asset in machine-readable form and shall be able to express at least purpose, onward sharing, provenance, AI use and logging; retention, revocation and the enforcement point to be added.

control: The policy attached to the catalogue entry is validated against the Level 1 profile

expressions.note: ODRL profile or the Level 1 vocabulary. Purpose and retention are covered by the templates of ptx:rule/L0-PURPOSE-LIMITATION and ptx:rule/L0-RETENTION.

source: DSSC decision log D-13 (to be merged with M3.policy.01)
